summary: The timed loop invokes SpMV for each requested iteration, while each invocation visits local rows and their full delimiter intervals. Native host assembly inlines this arithmetic and retains row/nonzero and outer iteration backedges.

source_evidence.claim: Local row delimiters terminate at the local column count; matrix pieces are transmitted/received by chunks. The kernel traverses every local row and nonzero, -i is parsed, timed calls repeat, and output rows are gathered.

compiled_evidence.claim: The actual timed runBenchmark path records MPI_Wtime and inlines the CSR work inside an outer iteration loop: indexed offset/column/value/vector loads, multiply/add and output stores are followed by nested row/nonzero branches and an iteration increment/compare/backedge before ending MPI_Wtime.
